steps.name: fresh-clone-esp-idf-v5-5-4
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=19999bde451f068ee503d4b7c9a0a91712709c2a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; IDF_ROOT="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; PARENT="$(dirname "$IDF_ROOT")"; TMP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.v5.5.4-fresh"; BACKUP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.pre-v5.5.4-backup"; test -d "$IDF_ROOT/.git"; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" remote get-url origin)" = 'https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git' || test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" remote get-url origin)" = 'git@github.com:espressif/esp-idf.git'; rm -rf "$TMP"; test ! -e "$BACKUP"; git clone --branch v5.5.4 --single-branch https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git "$TMP"; git -C "$TMP" submodule sync --recursive; git -C "$TMP" submodule update --init --recursive; test "$(git -C "$TMP" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test -z "$(git -C "$TMP" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; printf 'FRESH_IDF_COMMIT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$TMP" rev-parse HEAD)"

steps.name: activate-and-install-esp-idf-v5-5-4
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; IDF_ROOT="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; PARENT="$(dirname "$IDF_ROOT")"; TMP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.v5.5.4-fresh"; BACKUP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.pre-v5.5.4-backup"; test -d "$TMP/.git"; mv "$IDF_ROOT" "$BACKUP"; mv "$TMP" "$IDF_ROOT"; CLEAN_PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; env -u VIRTUAL_ENV -u CONDA_PREFIX -u PYTHONHOME PATH="$CLEAN_PATH" bash "$IDF_ROOT/install.sh" esp32s3; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH="$CLEAN_PATH"; source "$IDF_ROOT/export.sh"; idf.py --version | tee /tmp/idf-version-v554-recovery.txt; grep -Eq 'ESP-IDF v5\.5\.4($|[- ])' /tmp/idf-version-v554-recovery.txt; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test -z "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"

verify_steps.name: verify-growbox-build-and-finalize-idf-v5-5-4
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; IDF_ROOT="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; BACKUP="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf.pre-v5.5.4-backup"; CLEAN_PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH="$CLEAN_PATH"; source "$IDF_ROOT/export.sh"; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; idf.py --version | tee /tmp/idf-version-v554-final.txt; grep -Eq 'ESP-IDF v5\.5\.4($|[- ])' /tmp/idf-version-v554-final.txt; rm -rf build/idf-gate; bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test -d "$BACKUP/.git"; rm -rf "$BACKUP"; printf 'ACTIVE_IDF=%s
' "$IDF_ROOT"; printf 'ACTIVE_IDF_COMMIT=%s
' "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"; printf 'ACTIVE_IDF_TAG=%s
' "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)"; find "${HOME}/esp" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'esp-idf*' -print | sort
